tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of the current FL Studio session: tempo, active channels, and modified mixer tracks (including names, volumes, panning, routing, loaded plugins, and send routing to other tracks).

tools.name: get_browser_names
tools.description: Use this tool to collect browser contents. CRITICAL PATHS TO USE: 'Plugin database' (Use this to find instruments or generators for the Channel Rack)

name.description: The exact directory path to search.

fullRecursive.description: Use 1 for deep search, 0 for direct children only.

tools.name: show_or_hide_window
tools.description: Sets the visibility state (shows or hides) of specified FL Studio window. Use for requests to open or close windows.

window_name.description: The name of the window. Valid names: {VALID_WINDOW_NAMES}

state.description: The desired visibility state. Valid states: 'show', 'hide', 'open', 'close'.

tools.name: get_highlight_names
tools.description: Returns a list of all currently valid UI elements that can be highlighted. Call this tool to get the exact string names required for the 'show_highlight' tool.

tools.name: show_highlight
tools.description: Highlights a toolbar icon or UI element. Use when user asks to be shown something.

item.description: The specific UI element to highlight. CRITICAL: This MUST be an exact string returned by the 'get_highlight_names' tool. DO NOT guess or substitute. If the user's requested element (e.g., 'browser') is not in the returned list, you MUST NOT substitute it with a workaround like 'Add channel'. You must leave this tool uncalled and tell the user you cannot highlight that specific item.

tutorialName.description: A short label/identifier for the tutorial step (e.g., 'Open Piano Roll'). This is shown internally and used for grouping. ALWAYS provide a value.

tutorialCaption.description: The instructional text displayed to the user along with the highlight.Keep this very brief. Never say 'click here' as the user will need to click a Continue button to remove this message.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Starts playback in FL Studio.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stops playback in FL Studio.

tools.name: get_tempo
tools.description: Gets the current project tempo in BPM.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.description: Sets the project tempo.

bpm.description: The tempo in BPM to set the project to.

tools.name: list_channel_names
tools.description: Retrieves and lists all channels in the Channel Rack with their name and plugin. Returns a numbered list showing both the channel name and the underlying plugin (useful when channels have been renamed and the plugin name differs).

tools.name: select_channels
tools.description: Selects, deselects, or toggles one or more channels in the Channel Rack. Use this when the user says 'select [instrument name]' or 'select channel [n]'. The target can be a channel name or number — no need for the word 'channel' to be present.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

selected.description: 1 to select, 0 to deselect, -1 to toggle.

tools.name: rename_channels
tools.description: Renames one or multiple channels in a single call. If the user asks you to choose names (e.g. 'rename after colours'), generate them yourself and call this tool directly.

channel_mapping.description: Dictionary mapping 1-based visual channel numbers (or names) to new names. (e.g. {'1': 'Kick', '2': 'Snare'}).

tools.name: add_channel
tools.description: Use this tool to add a new instrument/generator to the channel rack. Effects are not for the channel rack. CRITICAL RULE: NEVER guess the plugin name. Before calling this tool, you MUST call get_browser_names with the path 'Plugin database' (fullRecursive=1).

plugin.description: The exact name of the generator plugin. Do NOT include folder paths or file extensions (like .fst).

tools.name: remove_channels
tools.description: Removes one or more channels from the Channel Rack. DESTRUCTIVE: if the matched channel's display name differs from its actual plugin (e.g. a channel named 'Sytrus' that is actually running Patcher), confirm with the user which channel they mean before removing — call list_channel_names first to check, and state both the name and plugin in your confirmation.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

tools.name: route_channels_to_mixer
tools.description: Routes one or more channels to a specified mixer track (useful for bus routing).

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected') for source channels.

mixer_track_target.description: The name or 0-based index of the destination mixer track (Master = 0, Insert 1 = 1).

tools.name: get_channel_volumes
tools.description: Returns the current volume of one or more channels in normalized, percentage and dB form. Use this before relative volume changes: - 'reduce by X dB' → get volume_db, calculate target_db = current_db - X, call set_channels_volume_db - 'reduce by X%' → get volume_percent, calculate new_percent = current_percent * (1 - X/100), convert to normalized (new_percent / 100), call set_channels_volume

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

tools.name: set_channels_volume_db
tools.description: Sets volume for one or more channels in the Channel Rack using decibels (dB). Channel Rack volume maxes out at 0dB (unity, normalized 1.0). Accepts either a single dB value for all channels, or a per-channel mapping. For relative changes, call get_channel_volumes first, calculate each target, then pass a mapping. Never interpret 'reduce by X dB' as 'set to X dB'. The default volume is -5.2dB.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected'). Pass 'mapping' to use per-channel values via volume_db.

volume_db.description: Either a single dB value (e.g. '-10') applied to all target_channels, or a JSON mapping of channel→dB (e.g. '{'1': -5.0, '2': -3.0}') for per-channel targets. Max is 0dB (unity). Use mapping for relative changes across channels with different starting volumes.

tools.name: set_channels_volume
tools.description: Sets the volume for one or more channels in the Channel Rack as a normalized value. Accepts either a single normalized value for all channels, or a per-channel mapping. For relative % changes, call get_channel_volumes first, calculate each target normalized value, then pass a mapping. For dB changes use set_channels_volume_db. The default volume is 78%.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected'). Pass 'mapping' to use per-channel values via volume.

volume.description: Either a single normalized value (e.g. '0.8') applied to all target_channels, or a JSON mapping of channel→normalized (e.g. '{'1': 0.7, '2': 0.9}') for per-channel targets. 1.0 = unity (0dB). 0.0 = silence.

tools.name: set_channels_pan
tools.description: Sets the stereo pan for one or more channels in the Channel Rack. Accepts either a single pan value for all target_channels, or a per-channel mapping.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected'). Ignored when 'pan' is a JSON mapping.

pan.description: Either a single pan value (e.g. '-0.5') applied to all target_channels, or a JSON mapping of channel to pan like {'1': -0.5, '2': 0.3} for per-channel pan. -1.0 is full left, 1.0 is full right, 0.0 is center.

tools.name: set_channels_colour
tools.description: Sets the color for one or more channels in the Channel Rack. Accepts either a single colour for all target_channels, or a per-channel mapping. The default channel colour is #5C656A

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected'). Ignored when 'colour' is a JSON mapping.

colour.description: Either a single colour (name like 'red' or hex like '#FF0000') applied to all target_channels, or a JSON mapping of channel to colour like {'1': 'red', '2': 'blue'} for per-channel colours.

tools.name: mute_channels
tools.description: Mutes, unmutes, or toggles the mute state of one or more channels.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

muted.description: 1 to mute, 0 to unmute, -1 to toggle.

tools.name: solo_channels
tools.description: Solos, unsolos, or toggles the solo state of one or more channels.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

value.description: 1 to solo, 0 to unsolo, -1 to toggle.

tools.name: set_step_sequencer_step
tools.description: Sets a single step in the step sequencer for one or more channels.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

step_number.description: Step position (1-16 for a standard pattern).

value.description: 1 to activate the step, 0 to deactivate.

tools.name: set_step_sequencer_pattern
tools.description: Sets a 16-step pattern for one or more channels. Can also clear a pattern (all 0s). For vague requests like 'add a beat', call once per channel with a distinct, musically sensible pattern per role — never the same pattern for 'all' unless asked.

target_channels.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based visual indices, names, or keywords ('all', 'selected').

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_pan
tools.description: Sets stereo pan for one or more mixer tracks. Accepts either a single pan value for all target_tracks, or a per-track mapping.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). For numbers: Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers (Insert 4 = 4). DO NOT subtract 1. Ignored when 'pan' is a JSON mapping.

pan.description: Either a single pan value (e.g. '-0.5') applied to all target_tracks, or a JSON mapping of track to pan like {'1': -0.5, '2': 0.3} for per-track pan. -1.0 is full left, 1.0 is full right, 0.0 is center.

tools.name: get_mixer_tracks_volume
tools.description: Returns the current volume of one or more mixer tracks in normalized, percentage and dB form. Use this before relative volume changes: - 'reduce by X dB' → get volume_db, calculate target_db = current_db - X, call set_mixer_tracks_volume_db - 'reduce by X%' → get volume_percent, calculate new_percent = current_percent * (1 - X/100), call set_mixer_tracks_volume_percent with the result.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_volume_db
tools.description: Sets volume level for specified mixer tracks using decibels (dB). Accepts either a single dB value for all tracks, or a per-track mapping. This sets ABSOLUTE dB values. For relative changes ('reduce by 5dB'), call get_mixer_track_volumes first, calculate each target, then pass a mapping.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). For numbers: Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers (Insert 4 = 4). DO NOT subtract 1. Pass 'mapping' to use per-track values via volume_db.

volume_db.description: Either a single dB value (e.g. '-10') applied to all target_tracks, or a JSON mapping of track→dB (e.g. '{'1': -5.0, '2': -2.0, '3': -2.0}') for per-track targets. Use mapping for relative changes across tracks with different starting volumes.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_volume_percent
tools.description: Sets volume level for specified mixer tracks as a percentage. 100% = unity (0dB, normalized 0.8). 125% = maximum (+5.6dB, normalized 1.0). Accepts either a single percentage for all tracks, or a per-track mapping. This sets ABSOLUTE percentages. For relative changes, call get_mixer_tracks_volume first, calculate each target, then pass a mapping.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). For numbers: Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers (Insert 4 = 4). DO NOT subtract 1. Pass 'mapping' to use per-track values via percent.

percent.description: Either a single percentage (e.g. '80') applied to all target_tracks, or a JSON mapping of track→percent (e.g. '{'1': 70.0, '2'': 80.0}') for per-track targets. 100% = unity (0dB). 125% = max. 0% = silence.

tools.name: rename_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Renames one or multiple mixer tracks in a single call. If the user asks you to choose names (e.g. 'rename after instruments', 'rename randomly'), generate them yourself and call this tool directly.

track_mapping.description: Dictionary mapping tracks to names. Master is '0'. Inserts match visual numbers (e.g. '4'). DO NOT subtract 1.

tools.name: add_effect
tools.description: Add an effect plugin to mixer track slot(s). NEVER guess the plugin name — always call get_browser_names first.

plugin.description: The exact plugin name to add. First call getBrowserNames with path 'Plugin database' (fullRecursive=1) to get valid names. Pass only the base name (e.g., 'Fruity Compressor').

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of tracks. Master is 0. Inserts match their visual numbers (Insert 4 = 4). DO NOT subtract 1.

slot_number.description: The visual mixer slot number (1 to 10). DO NOT subtract 1.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.description: Remove effects from mixer track slot(s). This cannot be undone via script — the effect and its settings are lost.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of tracks. Master is 0. Inserts match their visual numbers (Insert 4 = 4). DO NOT subtract 1.

slot_numbers.description: Comma-separated visual slot numbers to clear (1–10), or 'all' to clear all 10 slots.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_colour
tools.description: Sets the color of one or more mixer tracks. Accepts either a single colour for all target_tracks, or a per-track mapping. The default mixer track colour is #636C71

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1. Ignored when 'colour' is a JSON mapping.

colour.description: Either a single colour (name like 'red' or hex like '#FF0000') applied to all target_tracks, or a JSON mapping of track→colour (e.g. '{'1': 'red', '2': 'blue'}') for per-track colours.

tools.name: mute_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Mutes, unmutes, or toggles the mute state of one or more mixer tracks.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1.

muted.description: 1 to mute, 0 to unmute, -1 to toggle.

tools.name: solo_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Solos or unsolos one or more mixer tracks.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of track numbers, names, or keywords ('all', 'all_inserts', 'master', 'selected'). Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1.

value.description: 1 to solo, 0 to unsolo, -1 to toggle.

tools.name: reset_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Resets one or multiple mixer tracks to their default state. This resets volume to unity (0dB), pan to center, clears custom names, removes all effect plugins, clears all send routing to other tracks, and resets colours. This can be used as a substitution for deletion if the user agrees. Deletion is possible in FL Studio but you cannot do it.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of tracks to reset. Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers (Insert 15 = 15). 'all' or 'selected' also valid.

tools.name: get_mixer_routing
tools.description: Returns the full send/receive routing matrix for all active mixer tracks. Shows which tracks are sending to which destinations and at what level. Call this before setting up or modifying mixer routing.

tools.name: set_mixer_routing
tools.description: Sets up or removes a send from one mixer track to another. Use this to create send/return effects chains, group routing, or sidechain setups. To clear ALL sends from one or multiple track at once, use reset_mixer_routing instead. Call get_mixer_routing first to understand existing routing before making changes.

source_track.description: The source mixer track. Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1.

dest_track.description: The destination mixer track to send to. Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers. DO NOT subtract 1.

active.description: 1 to enable the send, 0 to disable it.

level.description: Send level as a normalized value (0.0 to 1.0). Default is 1.0 (full).

tools.name: reset_mixer_routing
tools.description: Removes ALL send routing from one or more mixer tracks in a single call — accepts 'all', a list, or 'selected'. Restores the default send to Master after clearing. For setting up a single send, use set_mixer_routing instead.

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of tracks to reset. Master is 0. Inserts match visual numbers (Insert 15 = 15). 'all' or 'selected' also valid.

tools.name: open_piano_roll_for_channel
tools.description: Opens the Piano Roll for a specific channel. Deselects all channels first, selects only the target channel exclusively, closes the Piano Roll if already open, then reopens it — ensuring the correct channel is always loaded even if the Piano Roll was already open on another channel.

target_channel.description: 1-based visual index or name of the channel to open the Piano Roll for.

tools.name: quantize_channel
tools.description: Quickly quantizes notes of the specified channel.

tools.name: get_playlist_track_names
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of all current Playlist track names. Use this before renaming to find the correct track index.

tools.name: rename_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Renames one or multiple playlist tracks in a single call. If the user asks you to choose names (e.g. 'rename after animals'), generate them yourself and call this tool directly.

track_mapping.description: Dictionary mapping track numbers to names. Playlist tracks are 1-based (e.g., '1': 'Vocals'). DO NOT subtract 1.

tools.name: set_playlist_tracks_colour
tools.description: Sets the color of one or more playlist tracks. Accepts either a single colour for all target_tracks, or a per-track mapping. The default playlist track colour is #485156

target_tracks.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based playlist track numbers (e.g. '1', '2,3,5'). DO NOT subtract 1. Ignored when 'colour' is a JSON mapping.

colour.description: Either a single colour (name like 'red' or hex like '#FF0000') applied to all target_tracks, or a JSON mapping of track to colour like {'1': 'red', '2': 'blue'} for per-track colours.

tools.name: get_plugin_parameter_list
tools.description: Lists all parameters for a specific plugin.

target.description: Channel (1-based index or name) or Mixer Track (Master=0, Inserts=1+)

slot_number.description: Visual mixer slot (1-10) for effects, or -1 for channel generators.

tools.name: get_plugin_parameter_value
tools.description: Gets the current value of a plugin parameter.

target.description: Channel (1-based index or name) or Mixer Track (Master=0, Inserts=1+)

param_identifier.description: The 1-based visual index (e.g., '1', '6') or exact name of the parameter.

slot_number.description: Visual mixer slot (1-10) for effects, or -1 for channel generators.

tools.name: set_plugin_parameter_value
tools.description: Sets the value of a plugin parameter.

target.description: Channel (1-based index or name) or Mixer Track (Master=0, Inserts=1+)

param_identifier.description: The 1-based visual index (e.g., '1', '6') or exact name of the parameter.

slot_number.description: Visual mixer slot (1-10) for effects, or -1 for channel generators.

tools.name: save_piano_roll_script
tools.description: Use this tool to save Piano Roll scripts.

source.description: The full Python code block for the script.

tools.name: run_piano_roll_script
tools.description: Runs a Piano Roll script. Opens the Piano Roll first if it isn't already visible. Suggest this tool when the previous interaction saw a piano roll script being written.

source.description: The full Python code block for the script.

comparison_basis: Runtime V2 的五项只读映射；没有此前完整现场目录，新增不表示宿主版本新增。
